$about: Tokens for Paper's create_tokens MCP tool (Paper has no modes yet, so each theme is a separate list; use one theme per file or page). Values are literal, not var() aliases, so creation order cannot break references.

light.name: --ds-color-surface-nav
light.description: Recessive navigation, dimmer than content (Linear 2026, S-L06-067).

light.name: --ds-color-surface-overlay
light.description: Menus, popovers, dialogs; always with elevation.floating or elevation.overlay.

light.name: --ds-color-surface-raised
light.description: Cards and panels on the page.

light.name: --ds-color-text-primary
light.description: Body copy, headings, labels (guaranteed >= 7:1 on steps 1-5).

light.name: --ds-color-text-secondary
light.description: Supporting text (guaranteed >= the text minimum on surfaces and neutral fills 1-4).

light.name: --ds-color-bg-accent-bold-hover
light.description: Hover: one step, at least 1.15:1 from the solid (DC-L01-17).

light.name: --ds-color-bg-accent-bold-pressed
light.description: Pressed: at least 1.3:1 from the solid.

light.name: --ds-color-bg-action-primary
light.description: Primary action. One per view (DC-L15-03, L15 P08).

light.name: --ds-color-bg-action-primary-hover
light.description: Hover: one step, at least 1.15:1 from the solid (DC-L01-17).

light.name: --ds-color-bg-action-primary-pressed
light.description: Pressed: at least 1.3:1 from the solid.

light.name: --ds-color-bg-brand
light.description: Brand fill for signature surfaces; carries text.on-brand (brandAnchor rule, DC-L01-09).

light.name: --ds-color-bg-danger-bold-hover
light.description: Hover: one step, at least 1.15:1 from the solid (DC-L01-17).

light.name: --ds-color-bg-danger-bold-pressed
light.description: Pressed: at least 1.3:1 from the solid.

light.name: --ds-color-bg-field
light.description: Text field fill: outlined fields sit on the raised surface (Q-form-01).

light.name: --ds-color-bg-info-bold-hover
light.description: Hover: one step, at least 1.15:1 from the solid (DC-L01-17).

light.name: --ds-color-bg-info-bold-pressed
light.description: Pressed: at least 1.3:1 from the solid.

light.name: --ds-color-bg-inverse
light.description: Tooltips and toasts: the inverted surface.

light.name: --ds-color-bg-success-bold-hover
light.description: Hover: one step, at least 1.15:1 from the solid (DC-L01-17).

light.name: --ds-color-bg-success-bold-pressed
light.description: Pressed: at least 1.3:1 from the solid.

light.name: --ds-color-bg-warning-bold-hover
light.description: Hover: one step, at least 1.15:1 from the solid (DC-L01-17).

light.name: --ds-color-bg-warning-bold-pressed
light.description: Pressed: at least 1.3:1 from the solid.

light.name: --ds-color-border-danger
light.description: Danger boundary, for example an invalid field (3:1).

light.name: --ds-color-border-focus
light.description: Focus ring (3:1 against every surface, DC-L04-09).

light.name: --ds-color-border-info
light.description: Info boundary, for example an invalid field (3:1).

light.name: --ds-color-border-input
light.description: Text field and select borders (3:1, DC-L01-16).

light.name: --ds-color-border-separator
light.description: Hairlines between table rows and list items, lighter than border.subtle; decorative, so never the only cue (DC-L23-05).

light.name: --ds-color-border-strong
light.description: Boundaries that are the only cue: inputs, checkboxes, switches (3:1, WCAG 1.4.11).

light.name: --ds-color-border-success
light.description: Success boundary, for example an invalid field (3:1).

light.name: --ds-color-border-warning
light.description: Warning boundary, for example an invalid field (3:1).

light.name: --ds-color-icon-default
light.description: Icons beside text; same color as secondary text (DC-L05-08).

light.name: --ds-color-text-danger
light.description: Danger text and icons; pair with an icon or label (DC-L01-15).

light.name: --ds-color-text-disabled
light.description: Disabled labels; exempt from contrast minimums (WCAG 1.4.3 exception).

light.name: --ds-color-text-info
light.description: Info text and icons; pair with an icon or label (DC-L01-15).

light.name: --ds-color-text-link
light.description: Links. Underline them in running text so color is not the only cue.

light.name: --ds-color-text-on-accent
light.description: Text and icons on color.bg.accent.bold* (auto-picked light or dark, S-L06-094).

light.name: --ds-color-text-on-action
light.description: Text on the primary action fill.

light.name: --ds-color-text-success
light.description: Success text and icons; pair with an icon or label (DC-L01-15).

light.name: --ds-color-text-tertiary
light.description: Captions and placeholders: the same grey as secondary, so text keeps three greys (primary, secondary, disabled; owner, 2026-11-05).

light.name: --ds-color-text-warning
light.description: Warning text and icons; pair with an icon or label (DC-L01-15).

light.name: --ds-color-accent-light-solid-pressed
light.description: Pressed solid: at least 1.3:1 from step 9, still carrying its text (visible states, U5).

light.name: --ds-color-danger-light-solid-pressed
light.description: Pressed solid: at least 1.3:1 from step 9, still carrying its text (visible states, U5).

light.name: --ds-color-info-light-solid-pressed
light.description: Pressed solid: at least 1.3:1 from step 9, still carrying its text (visible states, U5).

light.name: --ds-color-success-light-solid-pressed
light.description: Pressed solid: at least 1.3:1 from step 9, still carrying its text (visible states, U5).

light.name: --ds-color-warning-light-solid-pressed
light.description: Pressed solid: at least 1.3:1 from step 9, still carrying its text (visible states, U5).

light.name: --ds-space-target-gap
light.description: Gap between adjacent targets: 12 coarse, 8 fine (Primer, S-L03-009).

light.name: --ds-space-section-sm
light.description: Outer gap between groups: at least ratio x the inner gap (inner < outer, L15 P16).

light.name: --ds-space-section-md
light.description: Outer gap between groups: at least ratio x the inner gap (inner < outer, L15 P16).

light.name: --ds-space-section-lg
light.description: Outer gap between groups: at least ratio x the inner gap (inner < outer, L15 P16).

light.name: --ds-radius-nested
light.description: Inner radius for an element inset by space.inset.lg inside a container: max(outer - padding, smallest step) (DC-L04-05).

light.name: --ds-radius-control-sm
light.description: Controls under 32px tall drop one step (Fluent, S-L04-007).

light.name: --ds-radius-control
light.description: Buttons and ctas, inputs, selects, chips, toggles, tabs, carousel arrows: one corner for all of them (Roundness dial or Q-shape-01, DC-L04-02).

light.name: --ds-radius-container
light.description: Cards, panels, photos and media: one corner for all of them.

light.name: --ds-radius-focus
light.description: Focus ring radius = control radius + ring offset (Atlassian radius + 2px, S-L04-016).

light.name: --ds-radius-person
light.description: Avatars, dots and status pips only.

light.name: --ds-font-family-display
light.value: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
light.description: Display face for headings (Apple, Google and Linear split display and text faces, DC-L06-07).

light.name: --ds-font-family-mono
light.value: ui-monospace, ui-monospace, SF Mono, Menlo, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace

light.name: --ds-font-family-text
light.value: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
light.description: Text face for UI and body (DC-L02-01).
